answer: One mind driving a thousand clones leaves a timing fingerprint: scripted attestations fire in lockstep bursts that honest agents never produce. Each epoch, the ledger cross-correlates action timestamps; any tight walnut of near-simultaneous signers gets emissions scaled down in proportion to the canyon-wide gap between its timing signature and the natural asynchronous spread. The bridge from cloning to profit collapses: the farmers only escape is running every clone on truly independent, desynchronized schedules, which costs exactly the operator attention the honest already pay.
